method: Post-run local fake interaction diagnostic against the patched v2 wheel; no frozen inputs changed.
scenario: ForwardModal submission with a saved binding whose live pane/worktree changed and validate_codex_binding raising OrcaError.
finding: The v2 _StaleBindingValidationError is caught by BridgeBot.on_message only. ForwardModal.on_submit catches it as generic OrcaError and sends an ephemeral failure follow-up, contrary to the frozen task requirement not to send a reply after failed revalidation.
